web-guide-idea-7.audience: Indian families overseas balancing festivals with another time zone.
web-guide-idea-7.offer: Design a festival session around an overseas audience’s actual schedule. Explain the sequence and meaning so newcomers can follow, including family members who do not speak the regional language.
web-guide-idea-7.steps.0: Choose a time zone and send a short preparation note.
web-guide-idea-7.steps.1: Demonstrate a manageable ritual or festive activity with explanations.
web-guide-idea-7.steps.2: Invite questions and suggest a simple way to continue at home.
web-guide-idea-7.equipment: A phone, stand, Wi-Fi and the items needed for the selected tradition. Keep the activity achievable for people abroad.
web-guide-idea-7.returnReason: Build a seasonal calendar and alternate languages or regions. Viewers return when the timing and explanations consistently suit their family.
web-guide-idea-7.promotion: Advertise both India time and the target audience’s local time, plus any optional items to prepare.

web-guide-idea-7.metadataDescription: Host a festival broadcast timed for Indians abroad, explaining rituals and inviting questions. Learn what to offer, how to start and what equipment you need.
